findings.title: Missing regression coverage that parent+ selection includes dynamically spawned descendants
findings.evidence: tests/playbook-loop-seed.test.ts runs `node packages/cli/dist/index.js run --playbook=default --select improve+` and asserts spawned TASK.md files exist, while packages/core/src/select/resolver.ts has special frontier traversal for descendants; no assertion proves dynamically spawned descendants are selected/executed by the `+` selector after materialization.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the loop seed regression with a child output/check or marker and assert descendants spawned under `improve` are executed when using `--select improve+`.
findings.regression_check: Add/run a focused Vitest assertion in tests/playbook-loop-seed.test.ts for `--select improve+` executing spawned descendants.
